title: A Scalable Fog Computing Solution for Industrial Predictive Maintenance and Customization
content: This paper explores developing and deploying a fog computing platform tailored for industrial environments, focusing on predictive maintenance and advanced data management. The research investigates the integration of custom sensors and algorithms to meet specific industrial requirements, emphasizing the application of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models for predicting equipment failures. The study enhances proactive maintenance strategies and real-time decision-making by applying machine learning techniques within a fog computing architecture. The findings underscore the platform’s potential to advance industrial data processing, edge intelligence, and maintenance practices, contributing to improved efficiency and reduced downtime in industrial operations.
